name: Novotel Santa Cruz de la Sierra
desc: A dynamic atmosphere near the heart of Bolivia's largest convention center. From our beach-style pool to our co-working space, every corner is designed to inspire and energize. Delight in our restaurant's exquisite signature cuisine and our 5 versatile function rooms. Our bar, active in the center of the hotel, is the ideal meeting point. In addition, you can enjoy stunning panoramic views of the city.
address: AV ROCA CORONADO 901, ENTRE TERCER Y CUARTO ANILLO
